fields.description: Issue includes extensive local political coverage and commentary on Miami city commission elections and slates, criticism of public-utility influence and contracts (including Florida Power & Light Company and transit/bus arrangements), and discussion of Everglades drainage proposals. Also includes items on efforts to bring a Democratic national convention to Miami, local civic promotion and criticism of the newspaper’s impact on Miami’s reputation, advertisements, entertainment listings, and a stadium fundraising campaign for the University of Miami.
